difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a criterion for a continuous functor to define a morphism of sites: it suffices that the composites of the functor with a conservative family of points of the target define points of the source (statement lines 9423-9430). The proof is a complete argument: the stalks of the pullback at the members of the family are computed by a chain of equalities using the companion results (proof lines 9433-9443); the hypothesis then makes the composite of the pullback with each stalk functor exact (proof lines 9444-9445); and conservativity of the family makes the pullback exact, which is the definition of a morphism of sites (proof lines 9446-9448). The non-formal content is the computation of the stalks and the use of conservativity. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
